annotations.title: Do I need a visa for Thailand?

description: Use this when someone asks whether they need a visa to visit Thailand or how long they can stay visa-free with their passport: "do I need a visa for Thailand", "do US citizens need a visa for Thailand", "Thailand visa for UK citizens", "how long can Australians stay in Thailand without a visa", "is there still a 60-day visa exemption", "visa on arrival Thailand", "can I extend my visa exemption", "Thailand entry requirements 2026". Since 15 Sep 2026 passport holders of 60 countries get 30 days visa-free for tourism (the 60-day exemption ended), a few get 15 days or visa on arrival, bilateral agreements give 90, 30 or 14 days, and 21 countries lost visa-free entry. Returns the status for the passport, maximum days, the extension rule, the land-border limit, the free TDAC arrival card, and notes when the planned days or purpose need a visa, with sources. Do not use for long stays, retirement or work (which_thai_visa or thai_visa_details) or for other countries' entry rules.

days.description: Optional: planned days in Thailand on this trip.

nationality.description: The passport as the user says it: country or adjective, e.g. "American", "UK", "German", "Brazil".

purpose.description: Purpose of the trip (default tourism). Visa-free entry is for tourism only.

name: thai_entry_check

scope.description: answered, compared, or needs_input (then ask the user "question" first).

title: Do I need a visa for Thailand?
